purpose: Independent H2 adjudication of every eligible literature-to-data operationalization after separate AI and H1 reviews.

scope.allowed_inputs: The H2 comparison worksheet, AI and H1 payloads, cited frozen English formula evidence, frozen input schema and snapshots, exact implementation files, and deterministic edge-case tests.
scope.forbidden_inputs: Candidate dimensions, selected features, target counts, prediction outcomes, model performance, Qwen/Ollama, local model output, and external LLM APIs.

rules: Reopen the literature formula evidence and independently inspect the implementation, input snapshot, and edge-case tests.
Preserve protected literature evidence and keep source-reported and project-specified missing rules separate.
Approve only when the literature formula layer is eligible and every project operationalization field is complete, deterministic, source-compatible, T0-safe, outcome-blind, and hash-verified.
A disagreement is resolved by evidence and executable boundary behavior, never by a desired number of retained features.
An approved project operationalization cannot create missing English formula evidence or make a future outcome into a T0 feature.
